note: Both sets cover the same core facts (2500 g cool/martensite, 2900 g heated/austenite, 400 g total, 15-20C austenite range, 200C-to-cryogenic martensite range, 10 g per louver) and both duplicate claims heavily. B binds the 10 g maximum pull force to the louver correctly at least once, whereas A never does — A twice mislabels it as 'friction' (once altering it to '<10 g') and once binds it to the Flexinol wire instead of per louver. A also adds two vague, value-less claims ('phase transition | Martensite/Austenite') and drops the cool-martensite condition on the 2500 g claim, while B's main faults are one invented condition ('likely martensite phase based on context'), one spliced/fabricated quote, and a garbled quote on the 200C claim. A's quotes are somewhat more literal overall, but B gets more of the tricky bindings right.
